# LeakSanitizer suppressions for llcommon (the analysis workflow passes this file when it exists:
# .github/analysis/suppressions/<lib>-lsan.txt; see doc/clean/analysis.md). One reason per entry.
#
# The logging configuration watcher is allocated once, on purpose, and never freed: LLError::LogControlFile::
# fromDirectory() makes it with `new` (llerror.cpp, see the comment there). Logging runs during shutdown; freeing the
# watcher (an LLLiveFile with its Impl and its LiveFileEventTimer, which also owns an LLInstanceTracker entry) brings
# back destruction-order crashes. Every allocation of that chain has one of these frames.
leak:LogControlFile
leak:LiveFileEventTimer
